head: OIL -16%.
*GOLD +$180.*
*BTC ETFS -$1.3B.*
scenes.say: Oil crashed sixteen percent in one week. Gold climbed almost two hundred dollars. And Bitcoin funds lost one point three billion. Add a new Congress, a hot jobs report and a chip stock meltdown. This is your week in markets, in five minutes, with facts, not hype.

head: GOLD
scenes.say: Let's start with gold. On Monday it dipped to about three thousand eight hundred sixty six dollars an ounce. By Thursday it touched four thousand one hundred forty eight. That is almost three hundred dollars from low to high in four days.

head: CLOSE $4,063
*+4.6% ON THE WEEK*
scenes.say: Gold closed Friday near four thousand sixty three, up about four point six percent on the week. But Thursday's high did not hold, and Friday's strong jobs data took some shine off. The level to watch is four thousand seventy. Gold closed just below it.

head: PBOC BUYS GOLD
*24 MONTHS IN A ROW*
scenes.say: A big part of the gold story is China. On Saturday, the People's Bank of China reported its twenty fourth straight month of gold buying. In October it added about twenty six tonnes, reportedly its biggest monthly addition since buying restarted in November twenty twenty four.

head: YUAN 6.65
*STRONGEST IN 4+ YEARS*
scenes.say: Beijing is also tapping the brakes on its currency. The yuan hit about six point six five per dollar, its strongest in more than four years. So from November fifteenth, banks must hold six percent of foreign currency deposits in reserve, up from four. It's the first hike since twenty twenty one.

head: MIDTERMS:
*DEMOCRATS TAKE CONGRESS*
scenes.say: Now the United States. Tuesday's midterms reshaped Washington. Democrats took control of both the House and the Senate. Wall Street first cheered: on Wednesday, the Dow had what CNN called its best post midterm day in forty four years.

head: S&P 500 -4.4%
*IN ONE DAY*
scenes.note: FEAR: TIGHTER RULES FOR AI & DATA CENTERS
scenes.say: Then came Thursday. Fears of tighter rules for A I and data centers hammered chip stocks. The S and P five hundred fell about four point four percent in one session. For the week, it lost about two point seven percent, and the Nasdaq one hundred about five percent.

head: CRYPTO BILL
*GETS HARDER*
scenes.say: For crypto, the new Congress changes the math. The CLARITY Act already stalled in the Senate, and analysts now say it is harder to pass. Reports say Democrats want a broader bill with tougher consumer protection when the new Congress starts in January.

head: +165,000 JOBS
*FORECAST: ~60,000*
scenes.say: Then the Fed story. Friday's jobs report crushed expectations. The US added one hundred sixty five thousand jobs in October, against forecasts of about sixty thousand. Unemployment slipped to four point one percent.

head: DECEMBER HIKE?
*~80% ODDS*
scenes.note: OCTOBER: HOLD · 2 OFFICIALS VOTED TO HIKE
scenes.say: That matters, because the Fed is talking about hiking, not cutting. In October it held rates, but two officials voted for a hike. After the jobs data, markets priced roughly an eighty percent chance of a December hike, and the ten year yield rose to about four point eight six percent.

head: BITCOIN
*$81K → $75K*
scenes.say: Now Bitcoin. On Wednesday it climbed above eighty one thousand dollars. Then the tech selloff dragged it down, and on Friday it touched about seventy five thousand. It ends the week near seventy five thousand nine hundred, down about two percent.

head: ETF OUTFLOWS
*-$1.28 BILLION*
scenes.say: The pressure came from the funds. US spot Bitcoin E T Fs lost about one point two eight billion dollars in five sessions. Ether E T Fs lost about three hundred sixty five million. Reports say that pushed Bitcoin E T F flows for this year into negative territory.

head: ETHER
*-7.7% IN ONE DAY*
scenes.say: Ether had an even rougher ride. It reached about two thousand four hundred fifty on Wednesday, then lost almost eight percent on Thursday. It still finished the week roughly flat, near two thousand two hundred forty.

head: $2.85 BILLION
*FROZEN OR INTERCEPTED*
scenes.say: The biggest crypto story was the Binance hack. According to co-CEO Richard Teng, about six point three billion dollars in assets were hit on October twenty ninth. This week he said two point eight five billion is now frozen or intercepted, and users bear no loss.

head: $124 MILLION
*SWAPPED INTO BITCOIN*
scenes.note: THE HUNT FOR THE REST GOES ON
scenes.say: The hunt is not over. Blockchain analysts at Elliptic reportedly traced about one hundred twenty four million dollars of stolen funds being swapped into Bitcoin. The F B I has linked the attack to a North Korean hacking group.

head: $39 BILLION
*OF REAL ASSETS ON-CHAIN*
scenes.say: Now the quiet long term story: tokenization. According to R W A dot x y z, about thirty nine billion dollars of real world assets now sit on blockchains, across around forty networks. Think Treasury bills, private credit and funds, on crypto rails.

head: ETHEREUM
*$15 BILLION*
scenes.say: Ethereum leads with about fifteen billion, ahead of B N B Chain near six billion and Solana near five. Even in a weak crypto week, this keeps growing. That is why the rules in Washington matter so much.

head: BRENT
scenes.say: Oil had the wildest week of all. Brent crude fell from about one hundred seventeen dollars to around ninety eight, a drop of roughly sixteen percent. Wednesday alone took almost ten percent off the price.

head: WHY?
*BETS ON A US-IRAN DEAL*
scenes.say: The reason: after the midterms, traders started betting on a deal between the US and Iran, which could bring more oil to market. Cheaper oil means less inflation pressure, one of the few things working against a Fed hike.

head: NEXT WEEK:
*US CPI · TUE NOV 10*
scenes.say: So what's next? The big one is Tuesday, November tenth: US inflation for October. China publishes its price data on Monday, jobless claims come Thursday, and producer prices on Friday. The levels to watch: four thousand seventy on gold, and seventy five thousand on Bitcoin.

head: GOLD OR BITCOIN
*NEXT WEEK?*
scenes.say: So, after Tuesday's inflation report, which wins next week, gold or Bitcoin? Tell me in the comments. Subscribe for daily crypto and gold facts, and see you next Sunday. This is not financial advice, just data.
